rationale:
## Campaign Rationale – Topik 15 WP | Wheat | January 2026

These segments were prioritised because the reference date of 15 January 2026 aligns with the critical pre-tillering to tillering window for wheat, making this the optimal intervention point for weed control messaging; engagement signals further support prioritisation, with Madhya Pradesh WhatsApp hot leads averaging the highest propensity score (0.533) and Haryana and Bihar WhatsApp hot leads also clearing the 0.45 threshold, indicating near-term purchase intent across 1,508 targeted growers spanning Bihar, Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Punjab. The OOS inventory gate blocked 5 distributor-level segments in Bihar and Gujarat covering 57 growers where Topik 15 WP stock risk was flagged, preventing demand activation that could not be fulfilled and avoiding the reputational and conversion damage of unfulfilled rep or WhatsApp-driven commitments. For field teams, the cleared segments provide a prioritised call list of 79 rep-assist growers in Punjab and high-density WhatsApp pools in MP (205) and Haryana (196) to focus effort where stock is confirmed available. If conversion rates track to segment propensity scores (0.38–0.53 range), the campaign is projected to convert approximately 550–650 growers, with MP and Haryana hot-lead micro-segments (44 growers combined, avg score ~0.49) serving as the highest-confidence quick-win targets for the first 72 hours of outreach.
